subject: HMC Swindles status: tuning loop live, one stability risk before June
body:
Dmitri, Deshawn,

Status. Repro on the shipped tune_outputs hyperparameters is done and matched expectations. Our own tuning loop is live - we drive the 'objective' mode externally, starting from step_size 0.1 and a single leapfrog step, then let the optimizer walk from there. On the two easiest targets we're seeing effective-sample-size-per-flop gains of roughly 2.3x over vanilla HMC with the swindle estimators on, which is the headline we hoped for.

Risk: NeuTra preconditioner training occasionally diverges on our heaviest-tailed target - about 1 run in 6 - and a diverged preconditioner poisons everything downstream in the benchmark. Paloma has a checkpoint-and-retry wrapper in review; we want it merged at least two weeks before the June sweep so the 384-GPU week isn't spent babysitting restarts.

On track otherwise for the late-June benchmark and the July decision memo.

Wei
